item.description:
Conversation list redesign — Finder-style four-column layout with day grouping.

  • New row layout: Conversation | Cache | Context charge | Total. Cache shows warm/cold/new with a live countdown to expiry (or “Expired” for cold sessions). Context charge shows the projected next-turn cost — with a struck-through warm-state cost ahead of the cold cost on still-open cold sessions, so you can see what the cache miss will cost you.
  • Multi-day conversations now split into per-day rows, each carrying its own day’s spend. Slices get a “part N” badge so it’s clear they belong to one ongoing conversation.
  • Day groups (Today, Yesterday, …) get sticky section headers that pin to the top of the visible region as you scroll, with the day’s total to the right.
  • Window chrome: traffic lights, month picker, and column headers now share one continuous translucent panel — no visible seam between toolbar and column header (Finder pattern).
  • Visual polish: alternating row shading with parity flipped per group, pill-shaped row backgrounds, bold day labels, pixel-perfect column alignment from chrome through section headers down to row content.
  • Performance: 1Hz countdown ticks no longer stutter scroll on heavy histories — day groups are cached in @State and refreshed only when conversations or the selected month change; rows are Equatable so non-live rows skip body re-eval; Conversation cost properties are memoized at init.
